theme: Personal finance basics: emergency fund, 50/30/20 budgeting, good vs bad debt
headline: Building Your Financial Safety Net First
body: An emergency fund covers 3-6 months of expenses, protecting you from unexpected financial shocks and reducing stress.
caption: Before investing or tackling debt, establish an emergency cushion. This foundation helps you stay stable during life's surprises. #EmergencyFund #PersonalFinance #FinancialWellbeing #MoneyBasics #SmartSavings
